verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Qualcomm ships a developer ecosystem around this chip, including the AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub and GenieX. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy for those interfaces, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The docs cover only model optimization, conversion and deployment features, with no versioning or lifecycle commitments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
